# TRUE 82

> TRUE 82 is a free NBA draft game: you build a five-player lineup from random franchise-and-era tickets, then a BPM-based season engine projects whether that lineup could chase a perfect 82-0 record. No NBA team has ever gone 82-0; the best real season on record is the 2015-16 Golden State Warriors at 73-9.

## The game

- [TRUE 82](https://true82.net/): Play the draft game. Draw five NBA players from random franchise-and-era tickets and watch a BPM-based engine project how close your lineup gets to a perfect 82-0 season.

## Explainers

- [How TRUE 82 works](https://true82.net/how-it-works/): How the draft, the BPM-based season engine, roster-fit adjustments, and the solo, daily, weekly, duel, and league formats turn five drafted players into a projected 82-game record.
- [Can an NBA team go 82-0?](https://true82.net/can-you-go-82-0/): Why a perfect NBA season is so hard, the closest real near-misses (the 73-9 Warriors, the Lakers' 33-game win streak), and how TRUE 82 turns the question into a game.
- [What is BPM in basketball?](https://true82.net/what-is-bpm/): Box Plus/Minus explained. What it estimates (a player's per-100-possession value versus league average, from box-score stats), its limits, and why TRUE 82 builds a draft game on it.
- [TRUE 82 FAQ](https://true82.net/faq/): Common questions about what TRUE 82 is, how to play, the ways to play, why the engine uses BPM, whether 82-0 is actually possible, and where the player data comes from.

## Data

- [Box Plus/Minus at Basketball Reference](https://www.basketball-reference.com/about/bpm2.html?utm_source=true82.net&utm_campaign=llms): The advanced metric TRUE 82's player values are built on. Player and team history comes from Basketball Reference and Basketball Reference's Stathead (Sports Reference LLC).
